message.content:
Modulo 7:

- \(29 \equiv 1 \pmod{7}\), so  
  \[
  29^{13} \equiv 1^{13} \equiv 1 \pmod{7}.
  \]

- For \(5^{13}\): since \(5^6 \equiv 1 \pmod{7}\), and \(13 \equiv 1 \pmod{6}\),
  \[
  5^{13} \equiv 5^1 \equiv 5 \pmod{7}.
  \]

Thus,
\[
29^{13} - 5^{13} \equiv 1 - 5 \equiv -4 \equiv 3 \pmod{7}.
\]

The answer is 3.
